title: Button
description: shadcn-style button on the react-aria Button primitive. Callers pass intent props (variant, size), never class names. Primary is a glass pane lit from off-center; secondary and discrete are flat.

anatomy.description: The single root element, a react-aria Button. Carries data-slot="button", data-variant and data-size for styling hooks and tests.

usage: Use onPress and isDisabled (react-aria semantics), not onClick and disabled.
Variants: primary (default, one per view), secondary (supporting actions), discrete (toolbar and inline triggers). Sizes: mini, small, medium (default).
State styling keys off react-aria data attributes (data-hovered, data-pressed, data-disabled), so hover stays correct across pointer types.
There is no destructive variant yet; when one is added it MUST use the heartwood ramp, the identity's only red.
An icon inside the button is sized by the button; pass it as a child, do not size it yourself.
